content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-78. - Investigation, hearings.
content.summary:

               …

faqs.a:
The board may at any time make such investigation and hold such hearings as may be
               reasonably necessary to determine eligibility for retirement of a member, eligibility
               of surviving dependents, including questions of dependency of such survivors and ages
               of minor children and the marital status of anyone receiving benefits.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(C); Code 1981, § 26-34)
